sloka: नरकम् कालकम् चैव कालका अपि व्यजायत ।क्रौन्चीम् भासीम् तथा श्येनीम् धृतराष्ट्रीम् तथा शुकीम् ॥३-१४-१७॥
transliteration: narakam kālakam caiva kālakā api vyajāyata ।krauncīm bhāsīm tathā śyenīm dhṛtarāṣṭrīm tathā śukīm ॥3-14-17॥

translations.english: To Tamra were born, Krounchi, Bhasi, Syeni, Dhrutharashtri and Suki. Altogether they were five beautiful young maids famous in the world.
